newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invest 117 bln yuan on airports by 2000.
newsitem.headline: China to invest 117 bln yuan on airports by 2000.

text.p: The Civil Aviation General Administration of China is planning to invest 117 billion yuan in airport construction and improvement by 2000, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Advanced communication and navigation systems would be installed at the nation's 41 most important airports, which were used by 95 percent of Chinese air travellers, the agency said.
Investment between 1996 and 2000 would be four times as large as the 1990-1995 period, when China built 19 new airports and reconstructed 15 others, it said but gave no further details.
